values: An n=8 counterexample to Karpenko's gamma-filtration conjecture; v1.0. Complete negative answer at n=8: dimension17, even Clifford index256, original SB splitting field, e8 in gamma5. Credited consequence of prior Karpenko and related index/filtration results; later analytic proof and independently reproduced finite certificates. Priority unestablished; preprint and scoped verification archive. No firstness/current-openness claim. Extensively AI-assisted, unrefereed. https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1271
